title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Madaari
desc: After losing his son due to government negligence, Nirmal kidnaps the home minister's ten-year-old son. He demands justice and forces the administration to face his painful revenge.

title: Commando 2 - The Black Money Trail
desc: A four-member team embarks on a covert mission to capture Vicky Chaddha, a money launderer in Malaysia. Their plan falters when one member is shot, complicating everything dangerously.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

title: Awarapan
desc: Shivam, a hitman, is ordered to watch a woman. He finds out she's trapped in a trafficking ring and decides to help her reunite with her true love.

title: Bhakshak
desc: A struggling journalist investigates abuse cases hidden at a girls' shelter. Her relentless pursuit uncovers horrifying truths, and he risks everything to expose injustice and fight for the victims.

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart?

title: Coolie No. 1 (2020)
desc: When a matchmaker is insulted by Jeffrey Rozario, a rich businessman, he vows to exact revenge. As a result, he makes a porter pretend to be a rich man and marries him off to Rozario's daughter.

title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Kishen Kanhaiya
desc: Twin brothers Kishen and Kanhaiya, separated at birth - one rich, and one poor - reunite years later to join forces and battle evil, proving blood ties conquer all odds.

title: Akele Hum Akele Tum
desc: Rohit and Kiran, aspiring singers, fall in love and marry. But responsibilities weigh heavily, straining their bond until Kiran decides to leave, breaking Rohit's heart and dreams.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: De De Pyaar De 2
desc: Ashish Mehra, a London-based NRI investor, visits his girlfriend's family, but tensions escalate when her father discovers the truth about Ashish's real age.

title: Madgaon Express
desc: Childhood friends Dodo, Ayush, and Pinku head to Goa for fun, but a chain of impulsive choices, wild detours, and hilariously bad decisions turns their dream trip into total chaos.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Judaai
desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.
